US-Iran Tensions Escalate Over Shipping Routes and Nuclear Sites

The United States launched new strikes on Iran amidst escalating clashes over shipping routes in the Strait of Hormuz. Iran denied having a secret nuclear site at Pickaxe Mountain, located near its Natanz facility. President Trump warned Iran against shooting at ships, stating the US would bomb bridges and power plants, and also cautioned China and Russia against arming Iran. Meanwhile, Iran reported a sailor was killed in a Ukrainian attack on a vessel in the Caspian Sea, and the Houthis fired on Saudi oil sites.
